sn46.44:1.1: Then a certain bhikkhu approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn46.44:1.2: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘an unwise dolt, an unwise dolt.’
sn46.44:1.3: In what way, venerable sir, is one called ‘an unwise dolt’?”
sn46.44:1.4: “Bhikkhus, it is because one has not developed and cultivated the seven factors of enlightenment that one is called ‘an unwise dolt.’
sn46.44:1.6: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
